title: After a reset Remove is gone; adding again re-attaches the lines still there
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  4. On the customer page press New Work Order, choose unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and create the work order (it opens as an estimate). Note its number, for example S3780-15904.
  5. On the work order page, find the Maintenance schedule card inside the asset card at the top and press Expand.
  6. On the PM-A row press Add Service; in the Add PM-A to <work order number> window keep Add to this work order selected and press Add. The row now reads Added · 4 lines.
custom_steps:
1. Press Mark complete on the PM-A row (its button now). Keep On a work order with this work order chosen and Reset date today, and press Mark complete.
  2. Open the PM-A row's three-dot menu and read what it offers.
  3. Choose Undo complete. Wait for any toast to go, open the menu again and choose Remove.
  4. On the Lines tab delete one of PM-A's lines by hand (for example 'Air filter inspection'). Count PM-A's lines.
  5. On the card press Add Service on PM-A, then Add. Count PM-A's lines on the Lines tab and read the row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After Mark complete the menu does not offer Remove; it offers Undo complete. (If the card's menu has no Undo complete, the case fails at this step; to carry on with the next steps, use Undo complete from the asset's Maintenance tab.)
  • After Undo complete, Remove is offered and works.
  • After the deletion, three PM-A lines remain.
  • Adding PM-A again re-attaches the three lines still there and adds back only the deleted one: the Lines tab holds exactly 4 PM-A lines, not 7, and the row reads Added · 4 lines.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S16, S18; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R25: “Remove is not offered once the service has been reset, by Mark complete or by invoicing; Undo complete comes first, per S18-R17. Adding the service again after Undo or Remove re-attaches the lines still on the work order rather than adding them a second time, and adds only the lines no longer there”
  • S18-R17: “its menu offers Undo complete until the service's next cycle moves again”
